notes.title: First Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello Takers,

I have to thanks all those who choosed to play the game since the day one: Thanks you.

I have listen to the very few review and feedbacks I got. As a solo dev, believe me it is really hard to make everything right so you can be sure that I will fix all bugs the faster I can.

Updates list:
Remote action camera has been removed and deactivated to allow better control of the camera.

The quit menu will be less flashy: It is good for your eyes!

New music in the lobby 

Rage camera will cause less jittering and is closer to the character..

I may come with other updates in the coming days.

I have test the language/localization system and it does work for me (I m french) but it may be possible that not all words has been translated. So I apologize for it.

Have fun and don't forget to contact me and I will try to fix the problem you have pointed out.

Have fun with the game

The dev

notes.title: UPDATE N°4
notes.content:
Hello Takers,

Over the last few days, I've tried to implement a few improvements:

Gameplay Level:
The duration of the mission is extended thanks to the addition of a final room to cross before completing the level.

The filter that appears on the screen during rage mode has been redesigned to be clearer and increase visibility during it.

The action that lifts the opponent is more powerful with a more precise impact. This will be visible at ANNA and FUBUKI.

UI level:
The selection screen has undergone a slight redesign to improve the reading of each character's profile.

NEXT:
Another playable character? Martial arts fighter why not!

The developer.

notes.title: Demo Update 160624
notes.content:
Hello Takers!

I have work both on the game and its demo with a big concern: Is the game fun to play and is it easy to handle?!

The result is this list of updates:
Rotation camera fixed
Camera lag added (remove the impression of having the camera stuck to the back of the character
Scene camera removed (no more transition between them and the player character) More smoothness for the gameplay
The Drone UI has been lightened
The graphics has been improved and lightened as well which lead to better performance
No more skills Pop-Up on screen, replaced by icon appearing over the life and rage bar.

Battle UI is reshaped a bit to take less space on the screen
The pause feature returns in this version.

A lot of particle FX has been replaced
Battle sound are clearer
Overall, the battle is faster with less camera transition, you keep track of the player character while in the middle of the combat.

The surveillance drone looks far better less rigid

My To do list:

Translate the game in French, German, Chinese, Corean and Japanese

More characters, 2 more female fighters one with twin blade and one with double gun and rocket launcher!!

More battle stage (among them one challenging plateform stage)

A boss (big like Elden Ring or one small fast and smart like Nier Automata)

A trailer

You can also visit my youtube channel to see all my work as a solo dev!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4SK5Povncrw5rBtU5yupaQ]Oedipe Games Youtube Channel[/url]
